Core operator corpus covers Bool constants, not, implication, and/or/xor, equality, distinct, ite, and arity/type diagnostics.
Integer corpus covers representative linear/nonlinear arithmetic plus explicit div/mod audit cases.
Real corpus covers representative arithmetic, comparisons, proof-producing contradictions, and division audit cases.
Mixed arithmetic corpus covers to_real, to_int, is_int, and representative sat/proof/type-error scripts.
UF corpus gives each official UF logic sat, unsat-proof, and type-error coverage, plus quantified, shadowing, and quoted-symbol cases.
